title: Mean of a signed Fourier atom
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be nonzero, and fix $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. Choose a subset $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ with probability proportional to the absolute value of the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$, and evaluate the corresponding Fourier monomial at $x$, multiplied by the sign of that coefficient. The expected value is $f(x)$ divided by the sum of the absolute values of all Fourier coefficients of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: nonzero real-valued function on the Boolean cube
